runtimeRiskBinding.inheritExistingChecks: All existing plan/raw/body/source/target/UID/nonce/900-second/mode/static guards remain. Risk binding does not supply baseline data, backup freshness, READY status or operation approval.
runtimeRiskBinding.approvedFalseArtifact: A proposal file alone is insufficient. A trusted operator must attest the explicit risk decision in the separately authorized operation receipt. No automatic conversion of approved=false to execution authority.
runtimeRiskBinding.fixtureCompatibility: Existing owned authorization/1 may remain only on the explicitly isolated fixture branch so fixtures need not change; production accepts only the new strict version. Test that fixture/v1 cannot authorize production.
runtimeRiskBinding.futureCaptureApproval: approval-r7d-c3b-runner-controlled-preflight-v4.json only after implemented safety validation; v3 rejected by new source. No v4 artifact now.

closure.perInvocation: Future strict operator authorization binds risk ID/raw artifact hash, C3B release ID, stageActive=true, completionObserved=false and existing <=900-second window. No operator authorization generated now.
closure.closedMarker: Fixed receiptRoot/R7D-C3B.release-completed.json, if present (including malformed/unsafe entries), denies subsequent operations; never automatically delete or overwrite.
closure.operatorBoundary: The trusted release operator must publish the closure receipt at completion/revocation and must not mint stage-active authorizations afterward. The runner cannot infer business-stage completion from ledger count alone. Future release approval must include closure as a completion prerequisite.
closure.additionalGuards: Existing current-build/runtime locks remain; candidate deployment changes the locked build. Completion/revocation always wins over an unexpired short authorization.
closure.checks: Before credential access, before each client process/session, existing precommit authorize hook, and before backup acceptance. Expiry triggers rollback/STOP under existing engine rules, not down migration.

profileDesign.existingFields: Do not change endpoint/project/runtime/build/image identity or credential paths.
profileDesign.newExplicitObject: transportSecurity containing contract ID, raw risk proposal ref/hash, fixed port 5432 and C3B closure marker policy. Strictly validate exact fields.
profileDesign.versioning: The security contract has its own explicit version. Profile identity/address remains stable so the immutable existing draft and registry are untouched; new profile bytes remain part of package_hashes. Historical old source package remains reproducible from its evidence.
profileDesign.noCircularHashes: Risk artifact binds stable stage/migration/endpoint identities, not future package hash. Future profile pins risk artifact; future short authorization pins both new package and risk.

future001002: Risk scope covers their transport only. Existing rejection of unregistered production 001/002 plans is preserved. Separate plan authoring/approval/registration remains required; no hidden enabling in this change.
